description: This source file defines a Swift class `CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler` that conforms to `WKScriptMessageHandler`. It handles script messages received from a WebKit web view, specifically for actions related to the 'openclawCanvasA2UIAction' message, parsing the message contents, extracting actions, and dispatching them to a network or agent component. It includes logic for URL scheme and IP address validation, message handling, and interaction with network/agent components.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: A handler for WebKit script messages related to in-app Canvas A2UI actions, responsible for processing messages, validating, and dispatching actions.
